6.332 rsIncompatibleNestedAggregateScopes
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsIncompatibleNestedAggregateScopes is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function
and one or more aggregate functions that are nested within its Expression parameter references
multiple peer Groups.
